card.name: Space before dose numbers
card.fires_on: The space or small word just before a dose, duration or section number in dosing text, often after 'is', 'as a', or a drug name such as Bortezomib or fosaprepitant for injection.

modes.label: Space before a dose figure
modes.description: A bare space right before the numeric dose or duration after 'is', 'as a' or a drug name.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose of Bortezomib for Injection is<< >>1.3 mg/m 2 administered

modes.label: Linking word in dosing phrase
modes.description: A small word such as 'single' or 'for' inside a dosing sentence or table title.
modes.example: Bortezomib for Injection may be administered either as a<< single>> agent or in combination with dexameth
